usedFor: Each new or edited Airtable row gets its email or phone checked in ApexVerify.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify
bestTemplate.why: It checks each row on the spot, and you choose the verification type and target country.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” fires on edits, so a row can be verified again after any change.
